title: 河
teacherNotes: Teacher-approved final source for L205 河. Release integrated from latest origin/main complete through L204 流; earlier lesson dependencies are now satisfied on main. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only. Images must be square 1:1 compositions using approved lesson style and cast anchors, with no text, numbers, signs, labels, logos, zhuyin, or watermarks. Audio must be standalone OpenAI charAudio, whole-sentence AI audio, independent G02 teach audio, and independent G05 wrong-choice whole-sentence audio.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: origin/main production JSON through L204 流 plus current target 河
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, license plates, road signs, dish labels, or readable marks.

approvedSentences.text: 長長的車流像小河一樣。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 長長的車流像小河一樣
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 從高處或安全路邊看見一長排車流，像一條小河一樣延伸。畫面要清楚表現車流像小河，不可有文字、數字、車牌、路牌或標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 地上有小河，天上有星河。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 地上有小河天上有星河
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 畫面上下對比：地上有一條小河，天上有像河一樣的星河。畫面要童趣、清楚，不可有文字、數字、標籤或注音。
夜空中一道流星飛過天空。畫面要清楚呈現流星飛過，不可有文字、數字、標籤或災難感。
小女孩拿著一條緞帶和剪刀，像是在問要不要剪這麼長。畫面要安全，可有大人在旁協助；不可有文字、數字、標籤或危險使用剪刀的情境。

approvedSentences.text: 這道菜和那道菜都好吃。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 這道菜和那道菜都好吃
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 餐桌上有兩道不同的菜，孩子或家人覺得兩道菜都好吃。畫面不可有文字、數字、菜名標籤或餐廳招牌。
